# Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from 'lazysubmodules add -h'; do not edit.

Usage: lazysubmodules add <url> <path> (--branch B | --tag T | --tag-pattern P | --commit SHA)

Clone a repository with 'git submodule add' as a new submodule named after
its path, write its tracking configuration, check out the resolved commit,
write .lsm.lock and stage the result. Exactly one of --branch, --tag,
--tag-pattern and --commit is required. If a step after the clone fails,
the new submodule is removed again.

Options:
  --branch <branch>        track the tip of the remote branch
  --commit <commit>        track the commit (a full or abbreviated SHA)
  --include-prerelease     let a tag pattern select a pre-release tag
  --tag <tag>              track the tag
  --tag-pattern <pattern>  track the highest version tag matching pattern
